title: V5: штатное завершение узлов — RPC + POSIX сигналы + operator log
brief: Owner CY/lab debug requires predictable node stop (Ctrl+C in terminal, orchestrator scripts, future seal console). Today POST /v1/shutdown exists but is not wired to SIGINT/SIGTERM; killing pwmd aborts transport/seal loops without a single operator-visible reason in logs. Implement unified graceful shutdown path for RPC and POSIX signals with snapshot persist, peer close, loop drain, and Russian operator log line.

current_state.rpc: POST /v1/shutdown — handlers_shutdown.rs: ShutdownFull snapshot + shutdown_tx stops axum graceful_shutdown
current_state.gap: No tokio::signal handler; Ctrl+C/SIGTERM likely hard exit; English-only log; transport/seal tasks may outlive HTTP stop; CY launchers do not call /v1/shutdown on trap

entry_points: SIGINT (Ctrl+C) — primary operator path on Windows/Linux terminal
SIGTERM — service/docker style stop (Unix; document Windows Ctrl+C maps to SIGINT in console)
unified_shutdown.single_impl: graceful_shutdown_request(app, reason: ShutdownReason) async — reason enum drives log text

operator_log_ru.also_en: Optional duplicate #INFO: pwmd stopped by operator reason=... for grep compatibility

sequence: 1. Log operator stop (RU + reason) once — dedup flag
2. If cluster proposer in manual_rpc or mid-gate: best-effort abort in-flight round (document behavior)
3. Signal transport loops to exit (cancellation token or shutdown watch on App)
4. Seal loop / federation / snapshot loader: observe shutdown and exit cleanly (no new seal after flag)
6. Close peer sessions with explicit_shutdown where applicable
8. Final log: HTTP server graceful shutdown (existing EN ok)
